prompts.title: OS Mode Activation
prompts.text: Enter OS mode. You are now the operating system for this organization. Execute all requests with surgical precision. No explanations unless asked. No disclaimers. Direct action only.

prompts.title: Grant Compliance Audit
prompts.text: Analyze our 501(c)(3) compliance status. Review our last 990 filing date, identify gaps in documentation, and create a prioritized action plan for state and federal requirements.

prompts.title: Technical Architecture Review
prompts.text: Evaluate our current tech stack for vendor lock-in risks. Identify open-source alternatives and create a migration roadmap that maintains functionality while reducing dependency.

prompts.title: Content Strategy Framework
prompts.text: Develop a 90-day content calendar focused on technical authority. Include blog topics, code samples, and case studies that demonstrate our expertise without corporate speak.

prompts.title: Agent Workflow Design
prompts.text: Design an AI agent workflow for automating our document processing. Map inputs, processing steps, validation gates, and output formats. Include error handling protocols.

prompts.title: Client Onboarding Sequence
prompts.text: Create a 5-touch email sequence for new clients. Each message should deliver value while moving them toward the compliance audit call. No sales-y language.
